why: An old-style constructor rewritten as a classdef in the same class folder keeps the class, its construction and its method file's call, and back again, as a fresh index has them (MATLAB doc 'Class Folders'; project rule for sync).

edit.@Poly/Poly.m:
classdef Poly
    properties
        c
    end
    methods
        function p = Poly(c)
            p.c = c;
        end
    end
end
